_comment: Weights and thresholds for the deterministic recommendation scorer (next/recommend.js; brief §11). Tunable without code. Points are added per product: an intent the visitor chose from a suggestion is 'explicit' and lands on `explicitPrimaryMatch` when it is one of the product's primary intentTags; an intent read out of free text (model or keywords) is 'inferred' and lands on `primaryMatch`. Any detected intent that sits in a product's secondary tags earns `secondaryMatch`. Being in the visitor's goal candidate list earns `goalAlignment`. Bands (company size, creator volume, geography) score a fit when the product declares the visitor's band, a mismatch when the product declares bands and the visitor's is not one of them. A product's `excludesIntents` in solutions.json is the 'use-case mismatch'. Confidence: HIGH needs the top score at or above `minTopScore` AND a lead of at least `highGap` over the runner-up; MEDIUM needs the top score at or above `minTopScore` and a lead of at least `mediumGap`; anything else is LOW. The conversation keeps asking while confidence is below `stopAt`, or until `maxQuestions` discriminating questions have been asked.

pointers._note: Way-finding shown before the next question (Amy, 2026-09-10). With a top score at or above minTopScore the running is pointed at (up to fromReco products); with only a goal, the goal's first fromGoal candidates are named instead. A goal alone scores goalAlignment, so minTopScore above that keeps a bare goal from reading as a recommendation.
